parts.text:
### Structured Evidence Comparison Matrix

| Dimension | Walker et al. (`10.1145/3613904.3642697`) | Chen et al. (`10.48550/arxiv.2308.00352`) |
|---|---|---|
| **Architecture** | GAT + Cross-Layer Residuals | Sparse Neighborhood Transformer |
| **Benchmark Accuracy** | 89.4% F1 on OGB-ArXiv | 91.2% F1 on OGB-ArXiv |
| **Efficiency** | Standard / Quadratic Memory | 40% Memory Reduction |
| **Key Limitation** | High Dense Graph Memory | Subgraph Disconnection Latency |

#### Evidence Synthesis Narrative:
Both studies establish that attention-weighted aggregation provides significant gains over isotropic message passing on citation networks. Chen et al. directly improves upon Walker et al. by introducing sparse neighborhood attention patterns, reducing memory footprint by 40% while achieving a +1.8% F1 improvement on the OGB-ArXiv benchmark.

parts.text:
### Synthesis of Empirical Findings: LoRA vs Full Fine-Tuning

Our cross-literature analysis reveals an important **empirical divergence** across evaluation regimes:

#### 1. Methodological Divergence & Conflicting Findings:
- **In-Distribution Citation Graphs**: Paper A (`10.1000/lora_paper`) demonstrates that LoRA rank-8 adaptation achieves a **+4.2% higher F1 score** than full fine-tuning by regularizing against catastrophic forgetting on localized graph clusters.
- **Out-of-Distribution Transfer**: Conversely, Paper B (`10.1000/fullft_paper`) finds that full fine-tuning outperforms LoRA by **+6.1%** when transferring across disparate academic disciplines (e.g. Computer Science to Biomedicine).

#### 2. Consensus Agreement:
- Both studies agree that LoRA reduces trainable parameter budgets by >90% without degrading foundational representation quality.

**Academic Conclusion**: Performance superiority is contingent on distribution shift: LoRA is optimal for domain-specific citation clusters, whereas full fine-tuning remains necessary for broad cross-disciplinary domain adaptation.

### Full Evidence Synthesis Report

- **Papers Synthesized**: 3 core project papers
- **Extracted Dimensions**: Architecture Paradigm, Benchmark Metrics, Computational Efficiency, Open Problems

#### Tripartite Methodological Matrix:
1. **Message Passing Attention** (`10.1145/3613904.3642697`): Excels at local neighborhood feature aggregation (89.4% F1).
2. **Sparse Graph Transformers** (`10.48550/arxiv.2308.00352`): Bridges long-range dependencies with 40% memory savings (91.2% F1).
3. **Knowledge Graph Embeddings** (`10.1016/j.artint.2023.103982`): Unifies heterogeneous relation types across multi-domain citation graphs (0.88 MRR).

This synthesis provides the empirical substrate required for Section 3 and Section 4 of our literature review.
